sentence: AI capabilities reach sustainable SME performance through creativity and green innovation
passage: [Alwakid & Dahri (2025), p. 1] "The results indicate that AI capabilities significantly impact SME creativity and green innovations. Moreover, green entrepreneurial orientation positively influences SME creativity and green innovations, which in turn facilitate sustainable performance."

gemini.note: The passage clearly establishes the causal chain that AI capabilities impact creativity and green innovations, which then facilitate sustainable performance, fully supporting the sentence.
